summary: SuperX AI Technology Ltd sold 100% of OPS Interior Design Consultant Limited, its wholly owned Hong Kong subsidiary, to three individual purchasers who are OPS directors/founders. Total consideration was HKD 18,764,649 (~US$2,395,453), satisfied via assumption of an intercompany payable and set-off, with joint/several liability for any shortfall. The board approved on April 30, 2026; completion occurred May 7, 2026. All OPS contracts, assets, employees, and liabilities remain with OPS. The company expects a gain on disposal but no material adverse effect. Watch for completion disclosures and any earnout/indemnity claims.
